item.guhs.droomzand.lore: Glitters like a sleepy little star. The Sand Guh says: don't rub it in your eyes, vads!
block.guhs.zeepbelglas.lore: See-through, with every colour of a soap bubble. No poking, njeg!
block.guhs.droomzandblok.lore: Nine dream sands in one block. The glitter drifts up: it wants to go back to the stars.
block.guhs.slaapliedjesgras.lore: Hums softly when you walk over it. On tiptoes? Then it keeps sleeping.
block.guhs.maanbloemetje.lore: Only opens at night, and then glows softly. By day it naps, just like a vadsig guh.
block.guhs.droomzee.lore: The soft sea under the dream islands. You sink through it ever so slowly, like through a little cloud.
